entities.summary: James Edward Slattery was an American professional boxer who twice reigned as the NYSAC world light-heavyweight champion, once in 1927 and again in 1930. He was inducted into the Greater Buffalo Sports Hall of Fame in 1992, Buffalo Veteran Boxers Association Ring #44 in 1997 and the International Boxing Hall of Fame in 2006.
